gen-flavors-fs-amulya: Towering and a little goofy, Flavors stamps its tall lowercase across the top. And Amulya follows in a modern sans with generous curve gaps, low and easygoing enough that a long passage keeps moving.
gen-flavors-fs-chillax: Whimsical is the first word for Flavors, with its diagonals as heavy as its stems and a lowercase that towers. Chillax then drifts in below, its spaghetti-thin line and unfinished loops making a long passage feel loose and unhurried.
gen-flavors-fs-plein: Flavors stands tall, its lowercase rising like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke. Plein sits much lower beneath it, a clean sans with a clear channel leading into each round letter, so the big shapes above get steadier footing.
gen-flavors-fs-spline-sans: Flavors piles on whimsy, with diagonals as heavy as its stems and a lowercase that towers over everything near it. But Spline Sans is the real win here: its wide curve gaps and identical vertical and horizontal strokes make the whole pairing approachable.
gen-flavors-fs-synonym: Towering lowercase, drawn like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, gives Flavors its commanding, whimsical stance against anything beside it. Synonym's steady sans stripe is the answer.
gen-flavors-gf-aclonica: Aclonica stretches out as widely spaced sans-serif with a deep midsection and a thickness shift you feel more than see. Flavors is the showman, towering and whimsical; Aclonica just reads.
gen-flavors-gf-allerta: Flavors comes in tall, whimsical and smooth, with no calligraphic swelling anywhere. Allerta follows in loose, widely tracked sans-serif with a prominent x-height, so a long passage reads in an unhurried, open way.
gen-flavors-gf-alumni-sans: Clean and approachable, the body text has ascenders barely clearing its x-height and a wide-open c. Alumni Sans keeps its lowercase modest, while Flavors above it brings flat, unmodulated weight and a towering, commanding stance.
gen-flavors-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Alumni Sans Pinstripe brings tight word texture, rope-thick curves and oversized lowercase beside small capitals. And Flavors tops it with whimsical diagonals and a towering x-height, so the plain sans below reads as the quieter voice.
gen-flavors-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Contemporary and tightly squeezed, the body text sets its oversized lowercase beside small capitals. Flavors holds every stroke as steady as neon tube, while Alumni Sans SC adds the mild variation of a gently used dip pen.
